plugins.name: git
plugins.description: Git workbench side panel: review staged and working-tree changes (list/tree, unified/side-by-side diff), stage/unstage/discard, pull, push, stash, commit, and AI commit messages.

description_i18n.zh-CN: Git 工作台侧栏面板：列表/树结构查看暂存与工作区修改（统一/并排 diff），暂存/取消/撤销，图片新旧版并排比对，拉取/推送与 stash，AI 生成提交信息并提交
